summary: Tested mobile toggle Vista Móvil/Escritorio on ManagerDashboard at 390px viewport. Toggle button, hamburger Sheet menu, localStorage persistence all work. CRITICAL BUG: When 'Vista Escritorio' is forced on mobile, the desktop nav buttons (Servicios, Barberos, Inventario, Salir, Control de Accesos) remain HIDDEN (width=0, is_visible=False) so users cannot reach them, defeating the purpose of the toggle.
passed: Toggle button visible in header on mobile viewport (390px) with Monitor icon in mobile mode
Hamburger (☰) Sheet drawer opens in mobile default view showing all nav items: Control de Accesos, Servicios, Barberos, Inventario, Cerrar Sesión
Toggle click updates icon to Smartphone and applies 'force-desktop-view' class on <nav>
localStorage 'nexus_force_desktop' persists correctly across page reload (true after toggle, false after toggle back)
After reload with force-desktop=true, Smartphone icon is shown (state restored)

failed.area: ManagerDashboard - Forced Desktop View on Mobile
failed.issue: After activating 'Vista Escritorio' on mobile (390px), the desktop nav button group remains hidden. All buttons Servicios/Barberos/Inventario/Salir/Control de Accesos have bounding rect width=0 and are not clickable. Nav element scrollWidth=clientWidth=1024 (no horizontal scroll of buttons). Root cause: className `hidden ${forceDesktopView ? 'flex' : 'lg:flex'}` produces 'hidden flex', but in Tailwind v3, `.hidden` is defined AFTER `.flex` in the generated CSS, so display:none wins and buttons never render visibly.
failed.evidence: Playwright: 'Forced desktop - Servicios: count=1, visible=False' for all 5 buttons; getBoundingClientRect returned x=0,y=0,w=0,h=0; scroll_into_view_if_needed timed out because element is not visible. Screenshot m_desktop_scrolled.png shows only 'Nexus by CS2' title + toggle/theme icons — no nav buttons rendered.

action_items: Fix line ~198 of /app/frontend/src/pages/ManagerDashboard.js: change `className={\`hidden ${forceDesktopView ? 'flex' : 'lg:flex'} items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2\`}` to `className={\`${forceDesktopView ? 'flex' : 'hidden lg:flex'} items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2\`}` so `hidden` is only applied when NOT forcing desktop. This will make the nav buttons visible under horizontal scroll when forceDesktopView=true.
After fix, re-verify at 390px viewport: force desktop toggle should reveal Servicios/Barberos/Inventario/Salir with horizontal scroll enabled by .force-desktop-view CSS (min-width:1024px).
